description: This file defines the MessageString class, which encapsulates message details for error or informational messages within the OFBiz framework. It provides methods for creating message instances, filtering messages by field, and storing message-related metadata such as locale, property resource, and error status.

classes.name: MessageString
classes.description: A serializable class representing a message, with associated metadata such as field name, locale, error status, and source error.

methods.name: getMessagesForField
methods.description: Filters a list of message objects, returning only those associated with specified fields, optionally converting to string.

methods.name: MessageString (constructor)
methods.description: Initializes a MessageString instance with message content, field name, property info, locale, and error status.

methods.name: isForField
methods.description: Checks if this message is associated with a specific field.
